name: Intelligence Designed To Evolve
description: Modular AI platform designed for production. Black full-bleed video hero with a dot-matrix display headline, a vendor trust pill and a count-up stat footer.

typography.display: dot-matrix pixel display face (Bubbledot / Geist Pixel) for the hero headline only
typography.body: Inter / Segoe UI for everything else
typography.note: pair a novelty display face with a plain grotesque, never both novelty

layout: floating pill nav with burger drawer
trust pill with vendor logos + 'Trusted by 2000+ Enterprises'
motion: IntersectionObserver count-up on the stat numbers
pill nav lift shadow on scroll
voice: spec-sheet and quantitative - let the numbers do the talking, minimal adjectives
